title: Taking over a live platform after a one-month handover
tagline: Independently resolved 150+ production issues, cut a long-loading service-creation flow to seconds, and fixed a cross-timezone scheduling bug, working daily with Australian stakeholders.
context: The same live care-sector platform, used by 50+ organizations, 300+ clinicians and 2,000+ users, reached me as an inherited production codebase after a one-month handover.
challenge: A live system with real users arrived with a one-month handover. From then on I resolved production issues independently and shipped hotfixes directly to the client, from code change to deployment.
Two problems stood out: a service-creation workflow that took a long time to load, and appointments that showed the wrong time depending on the viewer's device.

approach.title: Take ownership of the inherited codebase
approach.text: Took ownership of the inherited production codebase after a one-month handover.

approach.title: Resolve issues and ship hotfixes
approach.text: Independently resolved 150+ production issues, shipping hotfixes directly to the client from code change to deployment.

approach.title: Speed up service creation
approach.text: Optimized PostgreSQL queries and API logic in the service-creation workflow, reducing a long-loading process to completion within seconds.

approach.title: Fix cross-timezone scheduling
approach.text: Fixed a scheduling defect so appointments display in each service's own time zone rather than the viewer's device time.

approach.title: Work with stakeholders every day
approach.text: Worked directly with Australian stakeholders every day on requirements gathering and live support.

outcome: A long-loading service-creation process now completes within seconds.
Appointments display in each service's own time zone, whatever the viewer's device says.
